definitions.explanation: All aspects or parts of something; the general or comprehensive scope.

examples.japanese: ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{全般|ぜんぱん}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{影響|えいきょう}→影響：01877_eikyou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧。
examples.english: It affects the economy as a whole.

examples.japanese: ⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧{全般|ぜんぱん}⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧⟦{話|はな}し{合|あ}った→話し合う：02396_hanashiau⟧。
examples.english: We discussed work matters in general.

examples.japanese: {全般|ぜんぱん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{良|よ}い→良い：02350_yoi⟧⟦{結果|けっか}→結果：02486_kekka⟧⟦だった→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Overall, it was a good result.
examples.notes: 全般的に = overall, in general

notes:
{全般|ぜんぱん} means the entirety or overall scope of something. It's used to discuss things comprehensively rather than specifically.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- 〜{全般|ぜんぱん}: ~ in general, ~ as a whole
- {全般|ぜんぱん}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧（に）: overall, in general

EXAMPLES OF USE:
- ⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧{全般|ぜんぱん}: the economy as a whole
- ⟦{健康|けんこう}→健康：02706_kenkou⟧{全般|ぜんぱん}: overall health
- ⟦{業務|ぎょうむ}→業務：09630_gyoumu⟧{全般|ぜんぱん}: business operations in general

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{全体|ぜんたい}→全体：03314_zentai⟧: whole, entire (more concrete)
- ⟦{一般|いっぱん}→一般：01737_ippan⟧: general, common
- ⟦{総合|そうごう}→総合：16986_sougou⟧: comprehensive, overall
